name: semantic-model-viewer
description: Explore Power BI semantic models with a table workspace, relationship filters, measure dependencies and DAX. Save complete interactive HTML snapshots for offline sharing.

semanticModelViewer.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Path to a `*.SemanticModel` folder or a `model.bim` to open by default, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Leave empty to choose from the models found in the workspace.

semanticModelViewer.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra glob patterns to skip when looking for models, e.g. `**/Archive/**`. Hidden folders (`.worktrees`, `.pbi`, `.venv`…), `node_modules` and `.git` are always skipped.

semanticModelViewer.cleaner.command.markdownDescription: Command used to run [Semantic Model Cleaner](https://github.com/MrPerfectH/Semantic-Model-Cleaner) (`pip install semantic-model-cleaner`). Report-usage badges are only ever shown from its `--format json` output.

semanticModelViewer.cleaner.reportsPath.markdownDescription: Folder searched for `*.Report` folders when the cleaner runs, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty = the workspace folder.

semanticModelViewer.cleaner.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the cleaner command line.

semanticModelViewer.cleaner.autoRun.description: Run Semantic Model Cleaner automatically whenever a model is opened or refreshed in the viewer.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No *.SemanticModel folder or model.bim found in the open workspace.

Open a folder that contains a Power BI project (.pbip) and the models appear here.
[Refresh](command:semanticModelViewer.refreshModels)

scripts.test: npm run sync-viewer && npm run check-viewer && node --test --test-concurrency=1 ../tests/*.test.cjs ../tests/extension.test.js ../tests/usage-adapter.test.js ../Models/tools/viewer/tests/*.test.js

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Model browsing is available; running Semantic Model Cleaner requires workspace trust.
